Comfort Babies

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
They are called reborn dolls, they look like real babies and for some they are.
These unique dolls are created specifically to order, you can design their features, choose their eye colour and age. Many people are using them as comfort after losing a child or if they can't have children of their own. They treat their reborns like real human babies, they dress them, cuddle them and take them on outings. They basically role play having a real child or children with the reborn

We spend time with three families, immersed in their reality.We will bath and dress and feed and hang out with them and their 'babies'




Further information:
Chanie - married with one child. Twins died and she had dolls made of them.
She takes the dolls shopping to fit clothes and they go for walks in the pram. They have saved her life she says
She also paints dolls for other people, so she can give us insight into the world of Reborn dolls

Chene has a syndrome that is called superwoman - develop puberty quickly, she has an extra X chromosome. She also has the syndrome where she can't stop eating, her brain never tells her she is full. She can't have children because she can't take care of herself. All she has ever wanted is to be a mom, so her mom bought her a reborn doll for her birthday and she is obsessed. Her mom says that it has changed her life and brought her so much happiness. She completely treats it like it is real, to her this is her baby. "This is her reason to wake up in the morning" says her mom. They had the baby made from a baby pic of Chene
Both her and her mom will be interviewed and we will spend the morning with Chene and her baby

Ronel is married, but she can't have children so she has four reborn babies
Boy - prem - Heindrick
Girl - selling it because she can't bond with her anymore. Had her for a year now and she just can't form a connection with her even though she has tried
Girl - Amy-Lee
They are very much apart of her everyday life and have helped her heal from not being able to have children

Script:


- Chantel – having a tea party
Reborn dolls are hypo realistic humanlike infant dolls or toddlers, For their moms these dolls are real babies who they take care of, interact with and love with all their hearts
- I am mom to 32 babies
- Introduce babies
In 2015 Chantel Venter suffered a miscarriage at 6 months pregnant, it was after this trauma that she bought her first reborn baby
Introduces the baby that she bought to help her heal
Chantel is not only a mom she is also a reborn artist
The reborn doll community is a massive business globally and locally, depending on their functionality dolls can fetch up to 45 000
Chantel: explains how the kits work and how they are reborn

Chene Botha has XXX syndrome, which means that even though she is 21 years old, mentally she is only about 7
Upsound Chene with baby getting dressed
Claire: Did she always want to have a baby
00:09:15:00 - 00:09:19:03
she wanted to have her baby over and then I'd be a mommy since she was very small.
Now she wants to be a mommy that's all she wanted to be is a mommy I think because of her syndrome. She wants to take care of someone then she'll feel better about herself.
00:08:27:17 - 00:08:50:14
I told her that since she was very small you will never be able to have your own baby because Mommy has to help you to do stuff

Searching on FB one day Chene’s mom Nadine botha saw a post for reborn dolls. Desperate to try and give her daughter a little bit of the life she craved she ordered Alyena
Verite beat with Chene and Aleyna
NADINE: And she's not stupid.
00:19:07:11 - 00:19:30:03
She knows and she cannot do stuff like other children she always talks about. She said I wish I could drive a bike. I wish I could go to school. I wish I could do this. So I think that Whole reborn baby is just it's something we can do for her. We are able to do it. And it's something she can experience so that alone is enough for me
Interview Beat with Chene: The kind of mom she wants to be and how she wants Aleyna to grow

Ronel Van Eck Beukes bought her first reborn baby in 2015 and since then she has added three new babies to her family
Verite scene with babies
00:07:50:17 - 00:08:21:27
Well I only got her recently her name is Annabell
So I still struggle a little bit to bond with her to get that emotional connection and was the little boy Hindru my husband's favorite.
00:08:23:19 - 00:08:34:20
If we could have kids that would have been its name
Ronel started adopting reborns after years of fertility treatment failed





00:03:34:01 - 00:03:54:14
well since my me and my husband I've been together and married and everything we tried and tried and tried and nothing ever happened. And. Two years ago I went to a gynecologist in My ovaries I have my own but everything is fine with my husband and I went on treatment that didn't work.
00:04:05:16 - 00:04:06:19
I fell pregnant once.
00:04:06:21 - 00:04:09:03
By that I had a miscarriage at
00:04:11:18 - 00:04:18:24
3 weeks and ever since it never happened again and it it it still hurts
00:04:20:17 - 00:04:55:05
so that's why it's in that comfort me a lot. It's very difficult for me to talk about it
Ronel Verite: I do talk to them and I know they can’t hear but they make me feel not judged
Ronel interview: If anyone says anything mean about them then I will get angry

Chantel: Tea Party role playing
Watching a grown women play with a doll makes most of us uncomfortable, its seen as socially unacceptable and strange for someone to treat a doll like a real live baby. But Chantel and her wife Manya don’t let other people’s opinions stop them from living freely with their children
Verite – they go out and Ackermans loves them
Chantel: How much she loves the doll and just like a real baby she doesn’t like just anyone to hold them
Ronel prefers to keep her babies private and has only left the house with them a few times
00:23:18:18 - 00:23:28:15
I try not to. I try not to take my babies out because I'm scared of judgment and
mY MOMS LOVES THE BABIES
mY HUSBAND LOVES THE BABIES
00:13:23:17 - 00:13:33:03
my husband's mom they live just across from us in the same flats. They also didn't have a problem with them
Mom and her outside:
Mom: she is my child and she loves them, so I love them
Ronel: 00:15:02:21 - 00:15:25:09
if I didn't have these babies then I I don't know
but they're all my reason in the morning to get up as well because I know I have
00:17:28:29 - 00:17:38:16
I have a purpose

Chene
00:16:33:12 - 00:17:04:04
I trained them before I gave the baby to I said to them how important it is so that we all treat the baby like a baby. We must never spoke of the baby As a doll. We must say it's a baby. Nice baby. So we she she calls and my husband Alina's oupa
00:18:26:09 - 00:18:29:23
It is. That is my grandchild yes.
00:19:35:10 - 00:19:46:12
Would you ever have thought that this that you would have treated the door like a real baby
00:19:46:14 - 00:20:02:10
Not at all s also funny
Claire: but they are not hurting anyone so what’s the harm
Chene: Without Aleyna I wouldn’t be where I am today, I would love myself like I do today
Verite: Buy horses, we are going to sleep now




Promos:
To everyone else these may look like ordinary dolls, but to reborn moms these are their children and they love them with all their hearts

Reborn dolls are made of vinyl and fabric, but to a reborn moms they are like a living breathing baby

Reborn babies may just be dolls to you and me, but for these reborn moms they are very real, filling the gab left by the loss of a child or the pain of infertility
